name: steel-dabba
description: A steel tiffin dabba (three stacked tiers, clip handle, lid knob) standing on the field with a haldi price sticker on the front. Params: price (number, Indian grouping, default 1499), oldPrice (optional number, struck through in red pen), label (optional small sticker line, default ''), tiers (2-4, default 3), x/y = top-left, width (default 640). Fully drawn at t=0 (good as frame 1); tossed in on the cut frame, the sticker is slapped on 0.4 s later and the strike draws after it.
